notes.title: Localization Update Out Now
notes.notes:
Hey Retropolis Fans!

Exciting news! Just a month after our launch, we're rolling out Update 0.68 for "Retropolis 2: Never Say Goodbye". Here's what's new:

🌍 Language Localization: We've gone global! The game now supports:
* Spanish
* Italian
* German
* French
* Korean
* Japanese
* Hebrew
* Enjoy the game in your preferred language!

🐞 Bug Fixes: Alongside, we've squashed some bugs to enhance your gameplay experience.

Keep the feedback coming, and stay tuned for more updates!
Happy Gaming!
Asaf from Peanut Button

notes.title: Retropolis 2: Never Say Goodbye - Hotfix Release Notes
notes.notes:
Hello, Retropolis Community!

First and foremost, we want to express our immense gratitude for the incredible support and feedback you've shown since the launch of Retropolis 2: Never Say Goodbye. Your enthusiasm and dedication have been nothing short of inspiring.

[b]What's New in This Hotfix:[/b]
We're excited to announce a hotfix that addresses the key issues you've helped us identify over the first weekend. Here's what we've fixed:

*[u]Game Crash at Electricity Puzzle (Episode 4):[/u]
We've identified and resolved the issue causing the game to crash during the electricity puzzle in Episode 4. You should now be able to solve the puzzle without any interruptions.

*[u]First-Person Head Model Visibility:[/u]
In some scenes, players reported seeing the first-person's head model from within. This has been fixed, ensuring a seamless and immersive gaming experience.
Other Minor Fixes:
Alongside these major fixes, we've also squashed some smaller bugs to enhance overall game performance and stability.

[b]We Need Your Help![/b]
Our journey doesn't end here! We rely on your feedback to make Retropolis 2 the best it can be. If you encounter any other issues or have suggestions for improvement, please don't hesitate to share them with us.

[b]How to Share Your Feedback:[/b]
Steam Community Forums: Join the discussion and share your thoughts on our official Steam Community page.
Reach us directly: Shoot us a message at our discord server, on our website, or in our designated support email.

Thank you for being a part of the Retropolis community. Your support and feedback are the cornerstones of our development process, and we're committed to providing you with the best gaming experience.

Happy gaming, and best regards,
The Peanut Button Team.

notes.title: 🎉 Retropolis 2 - A Landmark in Immersive Storytelling! 🚀 OUT NOW!
notes.notes: After an incredible journey, Retropolis 2: Never Say Goodbye is finally OUT! 🌟 With 2.5 million virtual brushstrokes hand painted in VRm and hours of dialogue, crafting this game has been a labor of love. Each detail, each conversation, is a piece of the immersive narrative puzzle we've carefully assembled. Our goal? To create a landmark in immersive storytelling that transcends the boundaries of gaming. Thank you for being part of this extraordinary adventure. 🤖💙 Let's embark on this groundbreaking journey together!

notes.title: It's festival season in Retropolis
notes.notes:
Hey all!
We have some amazing news to share with you: Retropolis 2: Never Say Goodbye was selected to join Raindance Immersive film festival, alongside amazing VR games and experiences. If you happen to be in London between October 25th to November 4th you can visit the physical installation of the festival and check out the Retropolis 2 demo and all the other amazing games that are part of the festival. You can find more details on the[url=https://www.raindanceimmersive.com/] festival website.[/url]

The second half of the festival will be held virtually in VRchat between November 4 to December 3rd, and at this time we are planning on having a Retropolis VRchat party, and we really want to see you all there!  

We’re still figuring out the details and the right time to do this, so if you want to be updated about the party, it’s better to [url=https://discord.com/invite/Q8uR46VZkB]join our community server on Discord[/url], where we will update about it as soon as we know. 

Until next time
Eyal from Peanut Button

notes.title: Retropolis 2 coming to Steam Next Fest with Episode 1 Demo!
notes.notes:
Attention, VR gamers! 
We are thrilled to announce that Retropolis 2 is blasting onto the scene at Steam Next Fest, and we're bringing you an exciting opportunity to experience the first episode as a free demo!

Prepare to immerse yourself in the futuristic metropolis of Retropolis 2, where thrilling adventures await at every turn. Explore the meticulously crafted world, uncover captivating secrets, and engage with cinematic narrative that will keep you on the edge of your seat.

But that's not all! To celebrate the demo , we invite you to join us for a livestream event on June 20th at 2PM ET. Get an exclusive behind-the-scenes peek at the creative process, interact with the developers, and witness Retropolis 2 in action.

Mark your calendars, rally your friends, and make sure you don't miss out on this thrilling experience. The Retropolis 2 demo will be available on Steam Next Fest, and our livestream will be your gateway to the future of gaming.
